prose: According to the Techmeme excerpt of a Truth Social post, Donald Trump says the White House considers anyone who uses the term Artificial Intelligence, instead of what he calls the more accurate Super Intelligence, to be 'THE ENEMY'. Only the excerpt was available, so the full post and context are not reviewed.
highlights: Trump post says use 'Super Intelligence', not 'Artificial Intelligence'
Calls those who do not the 'enemy'
Source is a Truth Social post via Techmeme
